$comment: Route set from the live sitemap (glaze.app/sitemap.xml) plus recon in specs/ and CLONE_SPEC.md. implementedBy is set only for sections that exist in src/ today.

meta.source: https://www.glaze.app (sitemap + Playwright recon); clone at this project root
meta.status: draft: landing, 5 persona routes and the 404 are built; the other templates are planned from the sitemap and still being specced

categories.SHELL: Chrome shared across pages: navigation, footer, overlays.
categories.SHOWCASE: Product-in-use displays: app tabs, grids, listings.
categories.CONTENT: Body content of a page: documents, articles, changelog, error states.
categories.STORE: App store browsing and app detail blocks.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed top navigation: glass pill on desktop (brand, Home, Pricing, Store, Blog, Changelog, Sign in) and a slide-down panel on mobile, with an active-link dot.
shell.navbar.scope: Present on all 1953 routes, including the 404.

shell.footer.description: Bottom footer with legal links, socials and the Raycast credit.
shell.footer.scope: Present on all 1953 routes, including the 404.

shell.youtube-overlay.description: Full-screen YouTube embed dialog opened from hero and feature demo buttons; locks scroll, closes on Esc or backdrop.
shell.youtube-overlay.scope: Carried by the landing page and the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

hero.landing-hero.description: Eyebrow, two-line headline, subtext, Download and Reinvent-your-wheel buttons, requirements note, autoplay loop video and three pillars; headline and subtext are swapped per persona route.
hero.landing-hero.scope: Landing page plus the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

showcase.persona-tabs.description: Six audience tabs (dropdown below 800px) each showing a four-app grid, with company logos on the team tab; the starting tab depends on the route.
showcase.persona-tabs.scope: Landing page plus the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

features.feature-grid.description: Six feature cards laid out 1 / 2 / 2 / 1, switching to mobile images below 800px.
features.feature-grid.scope: Landing page plus the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

support.faq.description: Ten-question single-open accordion that dims to 15% opacity once scrolled past.
support.faq.scope: Landing page plus the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

cta.download-icon.description: Large app icon that launches a burst of flying app icons on click, with the 'What will you build?' headline and download buttons.
cta.download-icon.scope: Landing page plus the 5 persona routes, 6 routes in total.

cta.download-page.description: Dedicated download page with the installer call to action and system requirements.

content.not-found-block.description: Centered error state with the clickable app icon, 'Page not found' heading, one sentence and a Go Home button.
content.not-found-block.scope: The catch-all 404 route, which also serves /m and the 6 persona-style slugs that do not exist upstream.

content.legal-document.description: Long-form legal text in a 640px column: Inter 48px title, last-updated line, h2 and h3 headings, paragraphs, nested bullet lists and underlined links.
content.legal-document.scope: The 3 legal routes: terms, privacy and acceptable use.

content.awards-body.description: Awards program page and its terms page content.

content.post-list.description: Blog index listing of post cards with image, title, excerpt and date.

content.article-body.description: Blog post header (title, date, author, hero image) and prose body.

content.changelog-entries.description: Chronological list of release entries with version/date headers and media.

commerce.pricing-plans.description: Plan comparison cards with prices and feature lists.

store.category-nav.description: Row of store category links (remixable, developer tools, productivity, utilities, media, design, lifestyle, games and fun).
store.category-nav.scope: The store index plus the 8 category routes, 9 routes in total.

store.app-grid.description: Grid of app cards (icon, name, tagline, author) for the store index or one category.
store.app-grid.scope: The store index plus the 8 category routes, 9 routes in total.

store.app-detail.description: Single app page: icon, name, author, download and remix actions, screenshots and description.
